CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT
AS
(
SELECT
BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,BLG.ACCT_NAME AS CustomerAccountName
,BLG.ACCT_OPN_DATE AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,BLG.ACCT_CLS_DATE AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,BLG.CIF_ID AS CustomerId
,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,BLG.GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE AS LedgerId
,BLG.LEDG_NUM AS LedgerAccountNumber
,BLG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,BLG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,BLG.SOL_ID AS BranchId
,BLG.ACCT_SHORT_NAME AS CustomerAccountShortName
,BLG.FREE_TEXT AS CustomerAccountNote
,BLG.LAST6_ACCT_NUM AS Last6AccountNumber
,BLG.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BLGD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST_DELTA BLGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLGD.ACID = BLG.ACID AND BLG.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,CustomerAccountNote
,Last6AccountNumber
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,CustomerAccountNote
,Last6AccountNumber
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT 
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE 
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = TGT.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName = SRC.CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate = SRC.CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber = SRC.GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId = SRC.ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId = SRC.SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId = SRC.LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber = SRC.LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId = SRC.CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber = SRC.CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId = SRC.BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName = SRC.CustomerAccountShortName
,CustomerAccountNote = SRC.CustomerAccountNote
,Last6AccountNumber = SRC.Last6AccountNumber
FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = TGT.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT SRC ON SRC.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = TGT.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID;

--INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,CustomerAccountNote
,Last6AccountNumber
,INSERTDTTM
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE    
)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,CustomerAccountClosedDate
,GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,CustomerId
,ResponsibilityCenterId
,SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,LedgerId
,LedgerAccountNumber
,IsoCurrencyCode
,CustomerAccountTypeId
,CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchId
,CustomerAccountShortName
,CustomerAccountNote
,Last6AccountNumber
,INSERTDTTM
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE  
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

END
